item.title: Road works at footscray, 7th August
item.description:

They have already taken over Chislehurst Road for long term works ( into 2027) and now they've started works at these traffic lights ! It took me half an hour to get from the top of Sidcup hill to the bottom - a journey that would normally take 10 minutes ! I am a frequent visitor to this area and was unaware of any water issues ( I'm usually the one that reports them!)
